# LightWebPres

> Markdown-based documents for reading, presentation and static publishing. Beta.

Readers use their browser. The web builder and CLI share the same engine; authoring agents and hosting are external. Tags filter authored content, not translate it or control access. Notes are published; the engine is not an HTML sanitizer.
